items.title: Edison International (EIX) CEO Warns Wildfire Reform Delay Could Trigger Credit Downgrades
items.summary: Edison International CEO has warned that California utilities could face credit downgrades if wildfire liability reforms are not passed by the August 31 legislative deadline. The comments highlight that unresolved wildfire risk may affect financing conditions for NYSE:EIX and its peers. A change in credit ratings could influence borrowing costs and ultimately affect what ratepayers are charged.
